28
Ɔsetie ho nhyira
1 # Lew 26 Na sɛ wotie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wobɛhwɛ na woadi ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so a, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma wo so akɔ soro asi asase so amanaman nyinaa so; #Deut 26.19 2na nhyira yi nyinaa bɛba wo so na abɛto wo, ɛfiri sɛ wotie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne. 3Nhyira bɛka wo wɔ kuro mu, na nhyira aka wo wɔ afuo mu. 4Nhyira bɛka wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba ne w’afieboa mma, w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma. 5#Dwom 121.8 Nhyira bɛka wo kɛntɛn ne wo mmɔre kodoɔ. 6Nhyira bɛka wo wo fieba mu, na nhyira bɛka wo w’adifire mu.
7AWURADE bɛma w’atamfo a wɔsɔre tia woɔ adi nkoguo w’anim; wɔnam ɔkwan koro so bɛfiri abɛhyia wo, na wɔnam akwan nson so adwane w’anim. 8#Lew 25.21 AWURADE bɛhyɛ nhyira ama no aba wo so wɔ w’asan so ne adeɛ a wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu, na ɔbɛhyira wo, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so. 9#Eks 19.5-6 Sɛ wodi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so na wonante n’akwan so a, AWURADE de wo bɛgyina hɔ ayɛ ɔman kronkron afa, sɛdeɛ waka wo ntam no. 10Na asase so aman nyinaa bɛhunu sɛ wɔde AWURADE din na afrɛ woɔ, na wɔbɛsuro wo. 11Na AWURADE bɛma nnepa abu wo so wɔ wo yafunu mu aba mu ne w’afieboa aba mu ne w’asase so aba mu, asase a AWURADE kaa wo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so. 12#Deut 15.6 AWURADE bɛbue n’adepa korabea a ɛyɛ ɔsoro no ama wo, na atɔ w’asase so osuo ne berɛ mu, na wahyira wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa; na wode bɛfɛm amanaman pii, na wo deɛ, woremfɛm obi hɔ biribi. 13Sɛ wotie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi sɛ wobɛhwɛ ayɛ a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛma woakɔ kan na worenka akyire, na wobɛkɔ soro ara, na woremmrɛ ase da; 14#Deut 5.32 Ne saa nti, mmane mfiri nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi mu biara ho nkɔ nifa anaa benkum nkɔdi anyame foforɔ akyi nkɔsom wɔn.
Asoɔden ho nnome
(Lewitikɔs 26.14-46)
15Nanso ɛbɛba sɛ, sɛ woantie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wobɛhwɛ ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi ayɛ a, nnome yi nyinaa bɛba wo so abɛmene wo. 16Nnome bɛka wo, kuro mu, na nnome aka wo, wiram. 17Nnome bɛka wo kɛntɛn ne wo mmɔre kodoɔ. 18Nnome bɛka wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba, w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma. 19Nnome bɛka wo, wo fieba mu, na nnome bɛka wo w’adifire mu.
20AWURADE bɛma nnome, benabɔ ne adapaabɔ aba wo so deɛ wode wo nsa bɛka ayɛ nyinaa mu de akɔsi sɛ wo bra bɔne nti wɔbɛdwɛre woɔ, na woasɛe ntɛm, ɛfiri sɛ woagya me. 21AWURADE bɛma ɔyaredɔm afam wo ho de akɔsi sɛ ɔbɛwie wo hyeɛ afiri asase a worekɔ so akɔfa no soɔ. 22#1 Ah 17.7 AWURADE de ɛfɔn,#28.22 ƐFƆN: Nyarewa a ɛtumi ma obi fɔn. ɔfoɛ ne ahuhuro ne ahohyehyeɛ kɛseɛ ne nkrantɛ ne ɔhoɔ ne ɔpoɔ bɛbɔ wo, na ɛbɛti wo de akɔsi sɛ wobɛsɛeɛ. 23#Deut 11.17 Na ɔsoro bɛyɛ sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ama wo, na asase ayɛ sɛ dadeɛ ama wo. 24Na AWURADE bɛma mfuturo ne nso atɔ sɛ osuo ama no agu w’asase so de akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ.
25AWURADE bɛma woadi nkoguo wɔ w’atamfo anim: Wonam ɔkwan koro so bɛfiri akɔhyia wɔn, na wonam akwan nson so adwane wɔn anim, na wɔbɛto wo apete asase so ahennie nyinaa mu. 26Na wo funu bɛyɛ ewiem nnomaa nyinaa ne asase so mmoa aduane, na obiara renka wɔn. 27#Eks 9.9 AWURADE de Misraim mpɔmpɔ ne nsisiiwa ne ntutuiɛ ne ntwom a wɔrentumi nsa bɛbobɔ wo. 28AWURADE de adammɔ ne anifira ne akoma mu ahodwirie bɛbɔ wo. 29Na wobɛkeka awia ketee sɛdeɛ onifirani keka sum mu, na w’akwan renwie wo yie, na hyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ wo afom wo afa daa nyinaa, na obiara rennye wo. 30#Yes 65.22; Deut 20.6 Wobɛgye ɔbaa aware, na obi ne no ada; wobɛsi dan, na worentena mu; wobɛtɛ bobeturo, na worente ɛso aba. 31Wɔbɛkum wo nantwie w’anim, na worenni bi; wɔbɛfa w’afunumu w’anim, na wɔrennane mma wo; wɔde wo nnwan bɛma w’atamfo, na worennya ɔgyefoɔ. 32Wɔde wo mmammarima ne wo mmammaa bɛma ɔman bi, na w’ani bɛhwɛ, na wɔn hwɛ ama w’ani atɔ sia daa nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ tumi biara nni wo nsam. 33#Ate 6.3 W’asase so aba ne w’adwumadeɛ nyinaa, ɔman a wonni wɔn na wɔbɛdie, na hyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ woɔ na wɔapɛkyɛ wo, nna nyinaa; 34na w’ani so adeɛ a wobɛhunu no bɛbɔ wo dam. 35AWURADE de akuro bɔne bɛbɔ wo wɔ nankoroma ne srɛ so a wɔrentumi nsa mma woɔ firi wo nan ase kɔsi w’atifi.
36 # Deut 4.28 AWURADE de wo ne wo hene a wobɛsi no wo soɔ no bɛkɔ ɔman a wo ne wo nananom nnim soɔ, na ɛhɔ na wobɛsom anyame foforɔ, nnua ne aboɔ. 37#1 Ah 9.7 Na wobɛdane ahodwirideɛ ne kasabebuo ne ɛfene, aman a AWURADE de wo bɛkɔ soɔ no nyinaa mu. 38#Yer 12.13; Mika 6.15 Wode aba pii bɛfiri akɔ afuom, na ketewaa bi na wobɛboa ano aba mu, ɛfiri sɛ ntutummɛ bɛdi. 39Wobɛtɛ bobe nturo na woadɔ mu, na nsa deɛ, worennom, na woremmoa aba no ano, ɛfiri sɛ mmoa bɛdi. 40Wobɛnya ngodua w’asase nyinaa so, na ngo deɛ, worensra bi, ɛfiri sɛ wo ngodua no bɛpore agu. 41Wobɛwo mmammarima ne mmammaa, na wɔrenyɛ wo deɛ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔbɛkɔ nnommumfa mu. 42Wo nnua nyinaa ne w’asase so aba, mmɛbɛ bɛfa. 43Ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo mu bɛkɔ soro akyɛne wo ara, na wo deɛ, wobɛsiane aba famfamfam; 44#Deut 28.12, 14 ɔno deɛ, ɔbɛfɛm wo adeɛ, na wo deɛ, worennya bi mfɛm no; ɔno bɛkɔ kan, na wo deɛ, woaka akyire. 45Na nnome yi nyinaa bɛba wo so abɛmene wo akɔsi sɛ wobɛsɛeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ woantie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wobɛdi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a ɔhyɛɛ woɔ no soɔ. 46Na ɛbɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ, wo ne w’asefoɔ ho daa.
47Ɛsiane sɛ woamfa anigyeɛ ne akoma pa ansom AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn w’ahonya mu nti, 48wobɛsom w’atamfo a AWURADE bɛsoma aba wo soɔ no, ɛkɔm ne sukɔm ne adagya ne nnoɔma nyinaa mu hia mu; na ɔde dadeɛ kɔnnua bɛto wo kɔn mu akɔsi sɛ ɔbɛsɛe woɔ. 49#Yer 5.15; Yes 33.19 AWURADE de ɔman bi bɛfiri akyirikyiri afiri asase ano aba wo so, ɔherɛ so, sɛdeɛ ɔkɔdeɛ tuo; ɔman a wonte wɔn kasa, 50#Dan 8.23; Kwa 5.12 ɔman a wɔn ani yɛ den a wɔnhwɛ akɔkoraa anim na aberanteɛ nyɛ wɔn mmɔbɔ. 51Na wɔbɛdi wo mmoa mma ne w’asase so aba akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ, na wɔrennya w’aburoo, nsa anaa ngo, w’anantwie mma anaa wo nnwan mma, kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ. 52Na wɔbɛka wo ahyɛ mu wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu akɔsi sɛ w’afasuo atentene a ɛyɛ den a wode wo ho too soɔ no bɛdwiri aguo, w’asase nyinaa so, na wɔbɛka wo ahyɛ mu wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu, w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no nyinaa so. 53#2 Ah 6.28-29; Kwa 2.20; 4.10 Na wobɛdi wo yafunu mu aba, wo mmammarima ne wo mma mmaa a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ama woɔ no nam, ahohiahia ne ahokyere a w’atamfo bɛma wo ho akyere woɔ no mu. 54Ɔbarima a ɔdwoɔ na ɔwɔ tema wɔ wo mu bɛnya ne nua ne ne kokom yerɛ ne ne mma nkaeɛ a wama no aka no ho anibɔne, 55sɛ ɔremma wɔn mu biara ne mma nam a ɔredie no bie, ɛfiri sɛ hwee nkae wɔ ne ho bio, — ahohiahia ne ahokyere a w’atamfo bɛma wo ho akyere woɔ, wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu no mu. 56Wo mu ɔbaa nso a ɔdwoɔ na ahodɔ ne mmerɛyɛ nti ɔnsɔ nhwɛɛ pɛn sɛ ɔde ne nan bɛsi fam no bɛnya ne kokom kunu ne ne babarima ne ne babaa ho anibɔne, 57na ɔbɛdi ne mma a wawo wɔn ne akyiriadeɛ wɔ kokoam, ɛsiane ahohiahia ne ahokyere a wo tamfo bɛma aba wo soɔ, wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu no nti.
58Sɛ worenhwɛ nyɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma yi mu nyinaa na worensuro din a ɛwɔ animuonyam na ɛho yɛ hu yi a ɛne AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no a, 59ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛma wo haw ne w’asefoɔ haw ayɛ nwanwa, ɔhaw akɛseɛ a ɛkyɛreɛ ne nyarewa bɔne a ɛkyɛreɛ; 60#Deut 28.27 na ɔde Misraim nyarewa a wosuro no nyinaa no bɛba wo so, na abɛfemfam wo ho; 61nso yadeɛ biara ne ɔhaw biara a wɔntwerɛɛ no mmara yi nwoma mu no, AWURADE de bɛba wo so akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ. 62#Deut 1.10 Na mobɛka nnipa kakraa bi, nanso kane no na mo dodoɔ te sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma, ɛfiri sɛ woantie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne. 63#Mmb 1.26 Na sɛdeɛ AWURADE ani gyee mo ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mo yie na wama moadɔre no, saa ara nso na AWURADE ani bɛgye mo ho sɛ ɔbɛsɛe mo na wadwerɛ mo; na wɔbɛtutu mo afiri asase a morekɔ hɔ akɔdi soɔ no so. 64Na AWURADE bɛbɔ wo ahwete aman nyinaa mu afiri asase ano akɔsi asase ano, na ɛhɔ na wobɛsom anyame foforɔ a wo ne wo nananom nni wɔn a ɛyɛ nnua ne aboɔ; 65na amanaman no mu nso worennya ahodwoɔ, na w’anammɔn rennya home; ɛhɔ na AWURADE bɛma wo akoma a ɛtuo ne ani a ɛyɛ samoo ne ɔkra a ɛkusa; 66na wo nkwa bɛsɛne w’anim ahinhim, na wobɛsuro anadwo ne awia, na worennye wo nkwa nni. 67Na w’akoma mu suro a wobɛsuro ne w’ani so adeɛ a wobɛhunu nti, anɔpa wobɛka sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ anwummerɛ ɛ, na anwummerɛ nso wobɛka sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ anɔpa ɛ! 68#Deut 17.16; Hos 8.13 Na AWURADE de wo bɛsane afa ahyɛn mu akɔ Misraim wɔ ɔkwan a mekaa wo ɛho asɛm sɛ worenhunu bio no so; na ɛhɔ na mobɛtontɔn mo ho ama mo atamfoɔ sɛ nkoa ne mfenaa, na obiara rentɔ mo mpo.

Nhyira bɛka wo wɔ kuro mu, na nhyira aka wo wɔ afuo mu. Nhyira bɛka wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba ne w’afieboa mma, w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma. Nhyira bɛka wo kɛntɛn ne wo mmɔre kodoɔ. Nhyira bɛka wo wo fieba mu, na nhyira bɛka wo w’adifire mu.
AWURADE bɛma w’atamfo a wɔsɔre tia woɔ adi nkoguo w’anim; wɔnam ɔkwan koro so bɛfiri abɛhyia wo, na wɔnam akwan nson so adwane w’anim. Na asase so aman nyinaa bɛhunu sɛ wɔde AWURADE din na afrɛ woɔ, na wɔbɛsuro wo. Na AWURADE bɛma nnepa abu wo so wɔ wo yafunu mu aba mu ne w’afieboa aba mu ne w’asase so aba mu, asase a AWURADE kaa wo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so. Nnome bɛka wo, kuro mu, na nnome aka wo, wiram. Nnome bɛka wo kɛntɛn ne wo mmɔre kodoɔ. Nnome bɛka wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba, w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma. Nnome bɛka wo, wo fieba mu, na nnome bɛka wo w’adifire mu.

AWURADE bɛma ɔyaredɔm afam wo ho de akɔsi sɛ ɔbɛwie wo hyeɛ afiri asase a worekɔ so akɔfa no soɔ. AWURADE de ɛfɔn, ɔfoɛ ne ahuhuro ne ahohyehyeɛ kɛseɛ ne nkrantɛ ne ɔhoɔ ne ɔpoɔ bɛbɔ wo, na ɛbɛti wo de akɔsi sɛ wobɛsɛeɛ. Na ɔsoro bɛyɛ sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ama wo, na asase ayɛ sɛ dadeɛ ama wo. Na AWURADE bɛma mfuturo ne nso atɔ sɛ osuo ama no agu w’asase so de akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ.
AWURADE bɛma woadi nkoguo wɔ w’atamfo anim: Wonam ɔkwan koro so bɛfiri akɔhyia wɔn, na wonam akwan nson so adwane wɔn anim, na wɔbɛto wo apete asase so ahennie nyinaa mu. Na wobɛdane ahodwirideɛ ne kasabebuo ne ɛfene, aman a AWURADE de wo bɛkɔ soɔ no nyinaa mu. Wode aba pii bɛfiri akɔ afuom, na ketewaa bi na wobɛboa ano aba mu, ɛfiri sɛ ntutummɛ bɛdi. Wobɛtɛ bobe nturo na woadɔ mu, na nsa deɛ, worennom, na woremmoa aba no ano, ɛfiri sɛ mmoa bɛdi. Wobɛnya ngodua w’asase nyinaa so, na ngo deɛ, worensra bi, ɛfiri sɛ wo ngodua no bɛpore agu. AWURADE de ɔman bi bɛfiri akyirikyiri afiri asase ano aba wo so, ɔherɛ so, sɛdeɛ ɔkɔdeɛ tuo; ɔman a wonte wɔn kasa, ɔman a wɔn ani yɛ den a wɔnhwɛ akɔkoraa anim na aberanteɛ nyɛ wɔn mmɔbɔ. Na wɔbɛdi wo mmoa mma ne w’asase so aba akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ, na wɔrennya w’aburoo, nsa anaa ngo, w’anantwie mma anaa wo nnwan mma, kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ. Na wɔbɛka wo ahyɛ mu wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu akɔsi sɛ w’afasuo atentene a ɛyɛ den a wode wo ho too soɔ no bɛdwiri aguo, w’asase nyinaa so, na wɔbɛka wo ahyɛ mu wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu, w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no nyinaa so. Na wobɛdi wo yafunu mu aba, wo mmammarima ne wo mma mmaa a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ama woɔ no nam, ahohiahia ne ahokyere a w’atamfo bɛma wo ho akyere woɔ no mu. Ɔbarima a ɔdwoɔ na ɔwɔ tema wɔ wo mu bɛnya ne nua ne ne kokom yerɛ ne ne mma nkaeɛ a wama no aka no ho anibɔne, sɛ ɔremma wɔn mu biara ne mma nam a ɔredie no bie, ɛfiri sɛ hwee nkae wɔ ne ho bio, — ahohiahia ne ahokyere a w’atamfo bɛma wo ho akyere woɔ, wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu no mu. Wo mu ɔbaa nso a ɔdwoɔ na ahodɔ ne mmerɛyɛ nti ɔnsɔ nhwɛɛ pɛn sɛ ɔde ne nan bɛsi fam no bɛnya ne kokom kunu ne ne babarima ne ne babaa ho anibɔne, na ɔbɛdi ne mma a wawo wɔn ne akyiriadeɛ wɔ kokoam, ɛsiane ahohiahia ne ahokyere a wo tamfo bɛma aba wo soɔ, wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu no nti.
Sɛ worenhwɛ nyɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma yi mu nyinaa na worensuro din a ɛwɔ animuonyam na ɛho yɛ hu yi a ɛne AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛma wo haw ne w’asefoɔ haw ayɛ nwanwa, ɔhaw akɛseɛ a ɛkyɛreɛ ne nyarewa bɔne a ɛkyɛreɛ; na ɔde Misraim nyarewa a wosuro no nyinaa no bɛba wo so, na abɛfemfam wo ho; nso yadeɛ biara ne ɔhaw biara a wɔntwerɛɛ no mmara yi nwoma mu no, AWURADE de bɛba wo so akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ. Na mobɛka nnipa kakraa bi, nanso kane no na mo dodoɔ te sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma, ɛfiri sɛ woantie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne. Na sɛdeɛ AWURADE ani gyee mo ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mo yie na wama moadɔre no, saa ara nso na AWURADE ani bɛgye mo ho sɛ ɔbɛsɛe mo na wadwerɛ mo; na wɔbɛtutu mo afiri asase a morekɔ hɔ akɔdi soɔ no so. Na AWURADE bɛbɔ wo ahwete aman nyinaa mu afiri asase ano akɔsi asase ano, na ɛhɔ na wobɛsom anyame foforɔ a wo ne wo nananom nni wɔn a ɛyɛ nnua ne aboɔ; na amanaman no mu nso worennya ahodwoɔ, na w’anammɔn rennya home; ɛhɔ na AWURADE bɛma wo akoma a ɛtuo ne ani a ɛyɛ samoo ne ɔkra a ɛkusa; na wo nkwa bɛsɛne w’anim ahinhim, na wobɛsuro anadwo ne awia, na worennye wo nkwa nni. Na w’akoma mu suro a wobɛsuro ne w’ani so adeɛ a wobɛhunu nti, anɔpa wobɛka sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ anwummerɛ ɛ, na anwummerɛ nso wobɛka sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ anɔpa ɛ! Na AWURADE de wo bɛsane afa ahyɛn mu akɔ Misraim wɔ ɔkwan a mekaa wo ɛho asɛm sɛ worenhunu bio no so; na ɛhɔ na mobɛtontɔn mo ho ama mo atamfoɔ sɛ nkoa ne mfenaa, na obiara rentɔ mo mpo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
